nodes.label: S-178 Gate: 0.5.3 Serve List Cache and Coalescing
Per-Server Scope List Cache with Generation-Guarded Coalescing
nodes.rationale: Eliminates repeated 48-63s skills ls --json subprocess spawns in src/core/api.ts via per-server per-scope copy-on-read caching, scope-keyed in-flight request coalescing, generation-guarded invalidation on every mutation, and injectable before/after listers in remove(), dropping warm global list latency from ~50-60s to 1.0 ms.
